svg.title: Where defects in the IL-12 / interferon-gamma axis cause MSMD (single colour)
svg.desc: The loop between macrophages and T cells or NK cells that controls mycobacteria, marked where inherited defects cause Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease: IL12B, IKBKG (NEMO) and IRF8 in making IL-12; IL12RB1 and TYK2 at the IL-12 receptor; IFNG and ISG15 in making interferon gamma; IFNGR1, IFNGR2 and JAK1 at the interferon-gamma receptor; STAT1 in activating the macrophage; and CYBB in the respiratory burst that kills the mycobacteria.
